from: Second Lieutenant Pat Q. Sample, Platoon Academics Representative, 1st Platoon, Alpha Company, Basic Officer Course 0-00
subj: Request for review of an unsourced learning objective on the phase examination

paragraphs.text: Purpose.  On behalf of the Alpha Company student population, I request review of one enabling learning objective assessed on the phase examination that no issued material teaches.
Discussion.  Reference (a) lists the objective as item 12.  Reference (b) does not present the material at any point.  Enclosure (1) records the examination items concerned.

subs.text: The objective is published in reference (a) under the lesson that should teach it, item 12 of 40.
Reference (b), the study guide issued for that lesson, does not use the term at any point in its four topics.
A search of the full text for the term and each synonym returned no result.

paragraphs.text: Remedies.  I request that the objective be removed from scoring, or that partial credit be awarded for the items concerned, or that the objective be resourced before the next examination.

poc: My point of contact information is 000-000-0000 or sample@example.com.
author: Sample
